bullets.text: Xbox Mode Launches - Xbox mode for Windows 11 PCs enhances gaming experience with a streamlined interface.
AI-Driven Security Innovations - Microsoft enhances security with AI capabilities in Microsoft Defender and Agent 365.
Phishing Threats Surge - Microsoft detects over 8.3 billion email-based phishing threats in Q1 2026.
CISO Risk Review Best Practices - Microsoft shares essential strategies for CISOs to conduct effective risk reviews.
AI Fuels Business Growth - Microsoft empowers organizations to leverage AI for innovation and operational efficiency.
Leader in API Management - Microsoft recognized as a leader in IDC's API Management 2026 Vendor Assessment.
Enhanced AWS Defense - Microsoft Sentinel UEBA expands to improve security across multi-cloud environments.
Azure Local Scales Up - Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud now supports thousands of nodes for larger workloads.
New Microsoft-OpenAI Agreement - Partnership evolves to enhance AI platform development and delivery.
Windows Update Experience Revamped - New controls give users more flexibility over update management.
